note: **18 Pelham Crescent, schedule 13 of the 1939 Register.** Alfred M Pike, hosiery manufacturer, widowed, who was at 20 Barrack Lane in 1921 with his wife Fanny. The ED letter code is not known - schedule 13 is unused in every book and none of them reaches Pelham Crescent.

census.source: 1939 Register, schedule 13, 18 Pelham Crescent - read from the page by A. Hagues; sub number 1. THE ED LETTER CODE IS NOT KNOWN for this household. Schedule 13 is unused in every book the record holds, and none of them reaches Pelham Crescent at that number: RMGC has 12 and 14 on North Road, RMGA is walking down Barrack Lane, and the rest of Pelham Crescent is RMGB at schedules 208 to 221; the 1921 census has Alfred Pike, 54, hosiery underwear manufacturer, at 20 Barrack Lane with his wife Fanny and three grown children. The birth year agrees, and he is widowed by 1939, so Fanny died between the rounds. Entered in the record as Alfred; the Register gives Alfred M
